topic: What antenna aperture size trade-offs exist between LEO and GEO satellites when optimizing gain and portability for CMOS-based ground terminals?
consensus_response: LEO satellites favor smaller apertures for portability, while GEO satellites use larger apertures for higher gain. Phased array technology balances size and performance, mitigating polarization mismatch and cross-polarization interference. Adaptive beamforming optimizes signal strength and reduces interference.
reference_context: SatCom systems involve trade-offs between aperture size, gain, and portability, with LEO and GEO satellites having different requirements.
